message: The other day, I was in the kitchen, trying to explain to my kids why we need smoke alarms. They were more interested in pretending to be firefighters than listening to my safety spiel! 😂 But it hit me — our escape plan had become a game to them. So, we turned it into a fun family activity, practicing our routes while pretending to dodge imaginary flames. It reminded me that safety doesn’t have to be serious; making it relatable and playful can really stick with them. Have you ever turned a safety lesson into a game?
